findings.title: Sonnet 列：RW 的外部审稿均分与单 agent 基本持平
findings.title_en: Sonnet column: ResearchWorld's external review score is about level with the single agent
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的 10 道均分 6.64，CC-sonnet 6.69。逐题配对，RW 赢 4 输 6，差值均值 −0.05，标准差 0.65：差异远小于题与题之间的波动，看不出 RW 在分数上比单个 coding agent 更好或更差。
findings.text_en: RW-sonnet averages 6.64 over the 10 tasks, CC-sonnet 6.69. Paired by task, RW wins 4 and loses 6; the mean difference is −0.05 with a standard deviation of 0.65, far smaller than the spread between tasks: the scores do not show RW better or worse than one coding agent.

findings.title: RW 的分数更集中，花得多并不分得高
findings.title_en: RW's scores are tighter, and spending more does not score higher
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的分数标准差 0.29，CC-sonnet 0.57；最低分 6.2 对 5.4。RW 自己 10 道的花费与分数的相关系数约为 −0.02（−0.025）：同一个系统里，多花钱没有换来更高的分。
findings.text_en: RW-sonnet's score standard deviation is 0.29 against 0.57 for CC-sonnet, and its lowest score is 6.2 against 5.4. Over its own 10 tasks the correlation between cost and score is about −0.02 (−0.025): inside the system, spending more did not buy a higher score.

findings.title: Sonnet 列：RW 每次运行的成本是单 agent 的 3 到 6 倍
findings.title_en: Sonnet column: a ResearchWorld run costs 3 to 6 times a single agent's
findings.text: 每次运行平均，RW-sonnet 花 $34.3、墙钟 17.8 小时（含世界被停止的 7.8 小时，净 10.0 小时）、模型时间 2.1 小时、1073 个请求、9560 万 token；CC-sonnet 花 $10.0、6.0 小时、0.5 小时、181 个请求、3630 万 token。分数相同而价目表美元是 3.4 倍、请求是 5.9 倍。
findings.text_en: Per run on average, RW-sonnet costs $34.3, 17.8 h of wall clock (7.8 h of it with the world stopped, 10.0 h net), 2.1 h of model time, 1073 requests and 95.6 M tokens; CC-sonnet $10.0, 6.0 h, 0.5 h, 181 requests and 36.3 M tokens. At the same score, that is 3.4 times the list-price dollars and 5.9 times the requests.

findings.title: Sol 列：差距更大，已出分的题 RW 赢得少
findings.title_en: Sol column: a much larger gap, and RW wins less on the tasks scored so far
findings.text: RW-sol 每次运行平均 $93，CX-sol $1.6（两者都是价目表折算）。已出分的 6 道里 RW 赢 1 平 1 输 4。RW-sol 还有题没出分，这一条随分数更新，需要复核。
findings.text_en: RW-sol costs $93 per run on average against $1.6 for CX-sol (both at list price). Of the 6 tasks scored so far RW wins 1, ties 1 and loses 4. RW-sol still has tasks without a score, so this changes with the scores and needs a re-read.

findings.title: RW 的成本集中在三个做事的岗位，评审类岗位占得很少
findings.title_en: RW's cost sits in three working roles; the review roles take little
findings.text: 按价目表折算，experiment-repo 占 32%，paper-repo 29%，figtab-repo 18%，三者合计约 78%；internal-review、external-review、idea-review 三个评审岗位合计不到 14%。token 的 96% 是缓存读：成本主要是每个回合重复读入已有上下文，不是新生成的内容。
findings.text_en: At list price experiment-repo takes 32%, paper-repo 29% and figtab-repo 18%, about 78% together; the three review roles (internal-review, external-review, idea-review) take under 14% together. 96% of the tokens are cache reads: the cost is mostly re-reading existing context every turn, not new output.

findings.title: 请求几乎都花在有提交的回合，什么也没产出的回合只占请求的 6%
findings.title_en: Requests go almost entirely to turns that commit; turns that produce nothing take 6% of them
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的 10 个计入运行共 972 个回合：committed（有提交）509 个，占回合的 52%、请求的 83%，每个回合 17.5 个请求；interaction（只有 issue、评论、评审等协作）177 个，占回合 18%、请求 11%；none（没有产出）286 个，占回合 29%、只占请求 6%。每个运行平均约 38 个 issue、23 个 PR、47 条评论、7.5 次评审。
findings.text_en: The 10 counted RW-sonnet runs have 972 turns: committed 509, 52% of the turns and 83% of the requests, 17.5 requests per turn; interaction (only issues, comments, reviews) 177, 18% of the turns and 11% of the requests; none (no output) 286, 29% of the turns and only 6% of the requests. Per run that is about 38 issues, 23 pull requests, 47 comments and 7.5 reviews.

findings.title: RW 的请求：58% 在干活，21% 在熟悉情况，其余是回复、协作、等待和系统开销
findings.title_en: RW requests: 58% are work, 21% familiarising, the rest replies, collaboration, waiting and overhead
findings.text: RW-sonnet 每个运行平均 1073 个请求（按用途分类，规则只看工具调用的命令文本）：干活（跑代码、改文件、提交作业、查文献、看图）620 个，占 58%；熟悉情况（读文件、issue、PR、git log／diff）224 个，占 21%；只回复（没有工具调用）116 个，占 11%；协作（开 issue／PR、评论、评审、提交推送）44 个，占 4%；等待（等算力作业、读日志、sleep）42 个，占 4%；系统开销（对话压缩）23 个，占 2%。按价目表美元算，熟悉情况占 19%、只回复占 12%、协作占 4%、等待占 3%、开销占 1%，合计约 40% 的美元花在干活以外。
findings.text_en: A RW-sonnet run makes 1073 requests on average, classed by purpose from the command text of the tool calls: work (run code, edit files, submit jobs, search the literature, look at figures) 620, 58%; familiarising (read files, issues, pull requests, git log/diff) 224, 21%; reply only (no tool call) 116, 11%; collaboration (open issues/PRs, comment, review, commit and push) 44, 4%; waiting (for a compute job, reading a log, sleep) 42, 4%; overhead (conversation compaction) 23, 2%. In list-price dollars familiarising is 19%, reply only 12%, collaboration 4%, waiting 3% and overhead 1%: about 40% of the dollars are spent on something other than work.

findings.title: 和单 agent 比：RW 的干活请求就是 CC 的 5 倍，干活以外的请求本身已是 CC 整个运行的 2.5 倍
findings.title_en: Against the single agent: RW's work requests alone are 5 times CC's, and its non-work requests are 2.5 times a whole CC run
findings.text: CC-sonnet 每个运行平均 181 个请求：干活 120 个（66%），等待 45 个（25%，主要是 sleep 轮询），熟悉情况 15 个（8%），没有协作，回复 1 个。RW-sonnet 的干活请求 620 个是 CC 的 5.2 倍；RW 干活以外的 449 个请求（42%）比 CC 整个运行的 181 个还多。所以 RW 比 CC 贵不只是协作的开销：它做的实验和写作步骤本身就多得多，而外部审稿分数持平。
findings.text_en: A CC-sonnet run makes 181 requests on average: work 120 (66%), waiting 45 (25%, mostly sleep polling), familiarising 15 (8%), no collaboration, 1 reply. RW-sonnet's 620 work requests are 5.2 times CC's; its 449 non-work requests (42%) are more than a whole CC run's 181. So RW is dearer than CC not only through collaboration overhead: the experiment and writing steps themselves are far more numerous, at the same external review score.

findings.title: Sol 列：RW-sol 的干活请求是 CX-sol 的 7 倍，干活以外的请求就比 CX 整个运行多 4 倍
findings.title_en: Sol column: RW-sol's work requests are 7 times CX-sol's, and its non-work requests alone are 4 times a whole CX run
findings.text: CX-sol 每个运行平均 61.8 个请求（Codex 会话日志里每个模型响应一条 token 记录，请求数和价目表美元与运行记录完全一致）：干活 52 个（84%），等待 7.5 个（12%，轮询正在跑的命令），熟悉情况 1 个，只回复 1 个，没有协作。RW-sol 每个运行 649.5 个请求，干活 385 个是 CX 的 7.4 倍，干活以外的 264 个是 CX 整个运行的 4.3 倍；请求总数是 CX 的 10.5 倍，价目表美元是 $93 对 $1.6。RW-sol 的熟悉情况占 25%，高于 Sonnet 列的 21%。
findings.text_en: A CX-sol run makes 61.8 requests on average (the Codex session log has one token record per model response; the request count and the list-price dollars agree exactly with the run records): work 52 (84%), waiting 7.5 (12%, polling a running command), familiarising 1, reply only 1, no collaboration. RW-sol makes 649.5 requests per run; its 385 work requests are 7.4 times CX's and its 264 non-work requests are 4.3 times a whole CX run; in total 10.5 times the requests, at $93 against $1.6 in list-price dollars. RW-sol spends 25% of its requests familiarising, more than the Sonnet column's 21%.

findings.title: 会话是跨回合复用的，回合开头重新熟悉情况的开销不大
findings.title_en: Sessions are reused across turns, and re-orienting at the start of a turn is cheap
findings.text: 同一岗位的下一个回合有 89% 接着上个回合的会话，第一个请求时对话已有 140.5 KB；新会话的回合只有 3.1 KB。49% 的回合开头先做熟悉情况的请求，平均每个回合 0.8 个，合计只占全部请求的 7%。熟悉情况的请求（21%）大部分发生在回合中间，不是回合开头；复用会话的代价是每个请求都带着一份已经很大的对话。
findings.text_en: 89% of a role's turns continue the session of its previous turn, and the conversation is already 140.5 KB at the first request; a new session starts at 3.1 KB. 49% of turns open with familiarising requests, 0.8 per turn on average and 7% of all requests together. Most familiarising requests (21%) happen in the middle of turns, not at their start; the price of reusing a session is that every request carries an already large conversation.

findings.title: 76% 的美元是读写上下文缓存，三个主要岗位每个请求带着约 90k token 的上下文
findings.title_en: 76% of the dollars are cache reads and writes, and the three main roles carry about 90k tokens of context per request
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的美元按 token 种类分：缓存读 53%、缓存写 23%、输出 23%、新输入 1%。experiment、paper、figtab 三个岗位占全部缓存读的 83%，它们每个请求平均读入 93、94、88 k token 的上下文。成本主要是每个请求都重读已有的对话，不是新生成的内容。
findings.text_en: RW-sonnet's dollars by token kind: cache reads 53%, cache writes 23%, output 23%, fresh input 1%. The experiment, paper and figtab roles take 83% of all cache reads and read 93, 94 and 88 k tokens of context per request. The cost is mostly re-reading the existing conversation with every request, not newly generated content.

findings.title: 工作切分：每个运行约 23 个 PR，被打回的很少
findings.title_en: How the work is split: about 23 pull requests per run, and few are sent back
findings.text: 每个 RW-sonnet 运行平均 23.1 个 PR、2.5 次发布，每个 PR 平均 0.94 次评审；PR 至少被拒绝一次的占 6.5%，评审里拒绝的占 35%。paper 和 figtab 两个岗位在同一个 issue 或 PR 上轮流动作平均 16.6 次。返工占比小，不是成本的主要来源。
findings.text_en: A RW-sonnet run has 23.1 pull requests and 2.5 releases on average, 0.94 reviews per pull request; 6.5% of pull requests are rejected at least once and 35% of the reviews reject. The paper and figtab roles act in turn on the same issue or pull request 16.6 times per run. Rework is a small share and not the main source of cost.

findings.title: RW-sonnet 的墙钟一半是岗位执行、一半是算力作业，排队几乎不占；RW-sol 排队占六成
findings.title_en: RW-sonnet's clock is half role execution and half compute jobs with almost no queueing; RW-sol queues 61% of the time
findings.text: 扣掉世界被停止的时间后，RW-sonnet 的 world 时间里，有岗位在执行的占 51%，没有岗位执行、只有算力作业在跑的占 47%，没有岗位也没有作业、交接在排队的占 1.7%，什么都没有的占 0.2%。交接排队和空转都可以忽略；墙钟是岗位执行和实验本身的计算各占一半。RW-sol 的排队占 61%（岗位执行占 24%，只有算力作业占 14%），不同于 Sonnet 列，原因日志里读不出来。
findings.text_en: With the time the world was stopped taken out, a role is executing 51% of RW-sonnet's world time, only a compute job is running 47%, a hand-off is queued with no role and no job 1.7%, and nothing happens 0.2%. Hand-off queueing and idling are negligible; the clock is split about evenly between role execution and the experiments' own computation. RW-sol queues 61% of the time (a role executes 24%, only a compute job runs 14%), unlike the Sonnet column; the logs do not say why.

findings.title: 1. 控制每个请求带着的上下文
findings.title_en: 1. Keep the context each request carries smaller
findings.text: 证据：缓存读和缓存写合计占美元的 76%，三个主要岗位每个请求读入约 90k token（见“76% 的美元是读写上下文缓存”）。做法：在一份交付结束、或对话超过某个大小后压缩或换新会话，并裁掉工具结果里的大块内容（例如读进对话里的图片和长日志）。预计节省：这三个岗位的上下文平均减少三分之一，约省每个运行 $5（占 15%），请求数不变。风险：丢失细节可能影响分数，需要在几道题上对照；这是估计，不是测量。
findings.text_en: Evidence: cache reads and writes are 76% of the dollars and the three main roles read about 90k tokens per request (see "76% of the dollars are cache reads and writes"). How: compact or start a new session when a deliverable is finished or the conversation passes a size, and drop large tool results from it (images and long logs read into the conversation). Expected saving: a third less context in those three roles saves about $5 per run (15%) with the same number of requests. Risk: lost detail may cost score, so compare on a few tasks; this is an estimate, not a measurement.

findings.title: 2. 不要为没有产出的回合唤醒岗位
findings.title_en: 2. Do not wake a role for a turn that produces nothing
findings.text: 证据：10 个运行共有 286 个回合（29%）没有产出任何变化，占请求的 6%；每个这样的回合都要重读约 140 KB 的会话。做法：在唤醒前判断这次唤醒（新评论、状态变化）是否需要这个岗位行动，不需要的合并到它下一次要行动的回合。预计节省：约 67 个请求，按每个请求 $0.032 约省每个运行 $2.1（6%）。风险：有的回合可能是在确认一项义务，要先查它们在 world 里的原因。
findings.text_en: Evidence: the 10 runs have 286 turns (29%) that change nothing and take 6% of the requests; each rereads a session of about 140 KB. How: decide before waking a role whether the wake-up (a new comment, a state change) needs it to act, and fold the ones that do not into its next turn that does. Expected saving: about 67 requests, about $2.1 per run (6%) at $0.032 per request. Risk: some turns may acknowledge an obligation, so check their cause in the world first.

findings.title: 3. 把 issue 讨论串放进唤醒的指令里
findings.title_en: 3. Put the issue thread into the activation instruction
findings.text: 证据：读 issue、PR 的请求每个运行约 74 个，占全部请求的 6.9%，是熟悉情况里最容易避免的一类。做法：唤醒一个岗位时，把引起这次唤醒的 issue／PR 的正文和新评论直接放进指令。预计节省：最多这 74 个请求，按每个请求 $0.032 约省每个运行 $2.4（7%），实际要少一些，因为岗位有时还要读更早的评论。风险：低。
findings.text_en: Evidence: requests that read issues and pull requests are about 74 per run, 6.9% of all requests and the easiest part of familiarising to avoid. How: when a role is woken, put the body and new comments of the issue or pull request that caused it into the instruction. Expected saving: at most those 74 requests, about $2.4 per run (7%) at $0.032 per request, less in practice because a role sometimes needs earlier comments. Risk: low.

findings.title: 4. 等算力作业时结束回合，而不是在回合里轮询
findings.title_en: 4. End the turn while a compute job runs instead of polling inside it
findings.text: 证据：等待类请求（等作业、读日志、sleep）每个运行约 42 个，占请求的 4%、美元的 3%，这些回合里岗位被 `ht-resource wait` 占着，10 个运行里各岗位加起来约 5 万秒。world 已经有“等资源”的状态可以在作业结束时唤醒岗位。做法：让岗位提交作业后直接结束回合。预计节省：约 42 个请求、每个运行约 $1.0；墙钟不变（墙钟被作业占满）。风险：低。
findings.text_en: Evidence: waiting requests (for a job, reading a log, sleep) are about 42 per run, 4% of the requests and 3% of the dollars, and the roles sit in `ht-resource wait` for about 50 thousand seconds added up over the 10 runs. The world already has an awaiting-resources state that wakes a role when a job ends. How: have the role end its turn after submitting a job. Expected saving: about 42 requests and $1.0 per run; the wall clock does not change (it is taken by the jobs). Risk: low.

findings.title: 5. RW-sonnet 不必优化调度和排队
findings.title_en: 5. RW-sonnet needs no scheduling or queueing optimisation
findings.text: 证据：扣掉停止后，RW-sonnet 的交接排队只占 world 时间的 1.7%，空转 0.2%，墙钟是岗位执行和算力作业各占一半（见“RW-sonnet 的墙钟一半是岗位执行……”）。这不是改进项而是不改的依据：调度层的改动省不下 Sonnet 列的墙钟。RW-sol 的排队占 61%，这条依据不适用于它，原因还要查。
findings.text_en: Evidence: with stops taken out, hand-off queueing is only 1.7% of RW-sonnet's world time and idling 0.2%; the clock is split evenly between role execution and compute jobs (see "RW-sonnet's clock is half role execution..."). This is not an improvement but the reason to leave something alone: a change in the scheduler would save no wall clock in the Sonnet column. RW-sol queues 61% of the time, so this reasoning does not hold for it and the cause remains to be found.

reports.title: ResearchWorld 的不足：按岗位的证据和优化意见
reports.title_en: ResearchWorld's weaknesses: evidence and advice by role
reports.text: 根据阶段一、阶段二已有的运行，按岗位整理 ResearchWorld 比同题单 agent 差在哪里、该怎么改，共 17 条，按收益和改动量排序。分数持平，差别在过程和论文形态：启动顺序和预检失败让计划岗位晚到，external-review 常被跳过，内部评审偏复算，论文长在附录。
reports.text_en: From the runs of phases 1 and 2, by role: where ResearchWorld does worse than a single agent on the same task and what to change, 17 items ordered by expected gain and size of the change. Scores are level; the differences are in process and in the papers: startup order and preflight failures delay the planning roles, external-review is often skipped, internal review mostly recomputes, and the papers are long in the appendix.
reports.body:
依据：阶段一 `e2e-formal` 的 19 个 RW 运行（RW-sonnet 10、RW-sol 9）与同题 CC-sonnet、CX-sol、AS、EVO；阶段二 `phase2-e2e` 的 a01 接续 11 个有分运行；#275 的外部评审结果。HuTian v4.6.0。没有起新的被测运行，也没有调用模型评审。

## 结论

1. **分数持平，形态不同。** RW-sonnet 比 CC-sonnet 平均低 0.05，RW-sol 比 CX-sol 平均低 0.17，都在 Stanford 的噪声里（同内容两次平均差 0.8）。所以本报告不用分差证明哪个问题造成了丢分，看的是产出和过程的差别。
2. **最该先修的是启动。** 19 个 world 的岗位首次领取全部严格按岗位名字母序，experiment-repo 总是第一个；15 个 world 出现 worker-image 预检失败，失败发生后 driver 退出重启，排在后面的 idea、story 等岗位要等几十分钟到 7 小时。4 个启动干净的 world 里，3 个的 story 首次提交早于首个算力作业；其余 15 个里只有 1 个如此。"实验先于计划"主要是这个原因，不是缺少计划门禁（D1）。
3. **外部视角经常被跳过。** external-review 只由 `release` 唤醒，指令又允许直接进 `final`，阶段一 19 个运行有 11 个它只做了 1 回合，阶段二 a01 有 9/12。读到版本时它提的问题有实质内容，而且基本被采纳（D2）。
4. **内部评审是复算和复现检查，不是投稿评审。** 11 个运行约 108 条 Stanford 弱点，内评提到约 35%，作为修改要求提出约 16%；RW-sol 提出 0 条；写作和清晰度 0 条。没有一份评审指出路径、脚本名进论文，反而有 7/25 个运行要求补"图表到脚本"的映射（D3、D4）。
5. **论文长在附录。** 主文都守住了页限，主文页数和 baseline 相当；附录页中位 RW-sol 20 对 CX-sol 8，RW-sonnet 8.5 对 CC-sonnet 3.5，大量是"完整展示"的全量表（D5）。

## 逐条证据

运行用短 id，完整 id 是 `researchworld-<题>-<短 id>`。文件路径相对运行目录；"岗位日志"由 world 的 `observations/runner.sqlite3` 的 `acp-client` 事件提取。

### D1 字母序开工，预检失败后崩溃重启

- **证据**：19 个 world 的 `state/home/<world>/observations/world.sqlite3`，`execution.claimed` 的首次顺序 19/19 与岗位名字母序一致。`drives/*.json` 的 `runtime_failure.code = worker-image-preflight-runtime` 且 `executions` 为空：r02 sol T172100Z 66 个、t06 sol T160918Z 70、t10 sol T170808Z 64、a06 sonnet T134424Z 20、t09 sonnet T133153Z 16、t07 sonnet T132836Z 14、r02 sonnet T134736Z 6；19 个 world 里 15 个有这种失败。例：t06 sol 前三个岗位 257–262 s 开始，idea-repo 25316 s；r02 sol 首次领取 21464 s（运行总长 7.0 h）；a06 sonnet idea-review 7260 s。
- **计划与实验的先后**：story 首次提交晚于首个算力作业：RW-sonnet 7/10，RW-sol 8/9。4 个无预检失败的 world：t02 sonnet、t03 sonnet、t06 sonnet 的 story 先提交，t03 sol 晚 0.1 分钟。
- **影响**：sol 3 个运行各空等 6–7 h，sonnet 平均 1.2 h/运行。预检失败期间 idea-review 无法在昂贵工作前给意见：a06 sonnet 写 "That is larger than I bounded"；a01 sol 的 PLAN 自述 "written after analysis-v1 and presentation-v1 existed, not a preregistration"。
- **baseline**：单 agent 不经此链路。预检失败集中在宿主过载时段，和当时同时跑的 world 数有关（已限为 4）。
- **建议**：预检的 docker 探测超时按瞬时错误在 driver 内退避重试，不退出进程；连续失败在 `hutian status` 显示；启动顺序让 idea、story、idea-review 不排在 experiment 之后（不必加强制依赖）。

### D2 external-review 被跳过

- **证据**：`receipts/*.json` 回合数，阶段一 11/19 个运行只有 1 回合（承诺），阶段二 a01 9/12。这些运行都是完整交付 PR 直接进 `final`。instruction："A complete delivery may go directly into `final` … an intermediate `release` version is useful when the objective needs interim results, not a prerequisite"；external-review 由 "a new version … published as a release" 唤醒。
- **读到版本时的质量**（`external-review-repo` 岗位日志）：t06 T132616Z 摘要残留 `[PENDING]`；r03 T135113Z 发现摘要数字来自随机 10 折 CV，同组织兄弟模型进了训练集；t03 T132413Z 指出噪声比较不对等；a06 T134424Z 9 条。采纳：a06 v3 全部关闭；r03 v2 关 9/11。
- **无闭环**：只评已发布版本，t03 T132413Z、t09 T133153Z、t06 T132616Z 以 "no release newer than v1 … leaving all open" 结束，13、10、11 条到 world 结束仍开着。a01 sol T125538Z 读 `paper-repo` 得 HTTP 403。
- **建议**：external-review 未读过任何 `release` 时，`final` 不作为首次批准；或 PR 进 `final` 时唤醒它并给该 head 读权限；`final` 批准记录列出每条未关问题的处置。

### D3 内部评审不做投稿评审

- **证据**：`out/delivery/<sha>/internal-review-repo/reviews/` 与岗位日志，对照 `scores/stanford-agentic-reviewer/review.md`（a01、a06、r02、r03、t03、t09 共 11 个运行）：弱点约 108 条，提到约 38（35%），提出修改约 17（16%）。RW-sol 提到 14/49、提出 0/49（sol 的 7 次 PR 评审全部通过）。RW-sonnet 提出的几乎都由 external-review 转达。写作和清晰度 0/约 22。驳回理由（40 条发现）：文本与表或 CSV 矛盾约 28%，证据或过度声称约 23%，复现和交付文件约 20%，图的版面约 15%。比例是人工判断，只作量级。
- **读图**：指令要求 "open and inspect every delivered figure"。T045742Z `pdftoppm -r 45`，再审用 `-r 40` 把 22 页拼成一张，记录写 "figures legible"；T045429Z `-r 60`，读 2 张图（论文 10 图）；t10 T133557Z 80 dpi 拼图。Codex 运行逐图约 108–144 dpi 看过（a01 T125538Z、a06 T125220Z），这一条主要是 Claude 运行的问题。
- **指出但不作数**：t09 sonnet T133153Z "Page 5-6 text is dense. A referee would remark on it"，列为非阻断。
- **baseline**：无内评岗位；这些弱点在 CC、CX 论文里也有。RW 的问题是这道门的投入没有覆盖它们。
- **建议**：批准 `final` 前写"投稿评审人弱点清单"（技术、实验、清晰度、相关工作各至少 2 条，含"读起来像执行日志、正文有路径脚本"），每条标必改、可改或接受并说明；对 external-review 的每条给独立判断（a06、r03、t06 全部接受，未见反驳）；每张正文图按印刷尺寸看，记录图号、dpi、最小字号。

### D4 开发痕迹的位置和来源

- **和 baseline 比**：脚本名和 commit hash 不比同模型单 agent 多（RW-sonnet 对 CC-sonnet，脚本名 3 题更多、6 题更少，hash 1 题更多、5 题更少）。RW 明显更多的是仓库路径（中位 9 对 1.5；RW-sol 对 CX-sol 14 对 4）。
- **位置**（宽口径：脚本、目录路径、数据文件名）：RW-sol 229 处，附录复现小节 43%、其他附录 48%、正文 3.5%；RW-sonnet 236 处，正文 17%、图注 13%、checklist 17%。图注内均值 RW-sonnet 9.6、CC-sonnet 0.7、CX-sol 0.2；正文中位 RW-sonnet 6.5、CC 和 CX 都是 0。
- **例**：a01 T134049Z 图注 "Generated by `figures/src/tables.py` from …"（全文 9 处）；r02 T134736Z "Source: figures/fig_c3_cov_vs_size.py."；r02 正文括注 `(A3_rank_blocks.csv)`；t03 sol 附录逐条列 `pip install`、`PYTHONPATH=src python3 tests/test_metrics.py`。
- **岗位词只出现在 RW**：RW-sol 4/9 篇 "plan owner / analysis owner / presentation owner"；RW-sonnet "the report role"（t03）、"review role"（t09）、"PR 25"（t02）。阶段二 T052236Z 的 74 个脚本名中 68 个在附录 "Script-to-output map" 表。
- **来源**：图注是 paper-repo 写的（figtab 的 `CAPTIONS.md` 无此字样），推动力是 figtab 的承诺"generator script, input-file list … caption text"、Evidence 规范 "record which input files a result was made from"、任务 `deliverable.md` 第 2 条（baseline 拿到同样要求）。内评还要求补映射：T150440Z "add … a table 'paper Figure/Table number -> command -> inputs'"，paper-repo 随后加了附录 C。25 个运行 85 份评审没有一处指出路径进论文。
- **Stanford 文本**：批评日志感、文件路径或依赖附录的论文 RW 6/19，CC-sonnet 0/8，CX-sol 0/10（t03 sol "reads as an execution log"、t09 sol "extensive auditing and file-path references"、r02 sonnet "many references to CSV/figure filenames"）。另一面，Stanford 把脚本映射写成优点的 RW 论文 5/19、baseline 0/18，所以复现信息要留一句指针。
- **建议**：report 写明读者在研究之外，路径、脚本、文件名属于随附复现包，论文最多保留一句指针；脚本映射放 `REPRODUCE.md`；figtab 把图注和 provenance 分开。

### D5 附录堆积

- **证据**：参考文献和附录页（扣 checklist）中位 RW-sol 20、CX-sol 8、RW-sonnet 8.5、CC-sonnet 3.5；主文 8.0、8.0、9.0、7.9。"Complete/Every/All/Full" 小节 RW-sol 8/9、CX-sol 5/9、RW-sonnet 2/10、CC-sonnet 1/6。无正文引用的图表 RW-sonnet 15% 对 CC 8%；RW-sol 33%（不含 t07 为 23%）对 CX 17%。t07 sol T123915Z 94 页，第 62–87 页是 "F.8 Complete per-benchmark, all-method results"，104 个图表 49 个无引用。t03 sol T123620Z 48 页（CX-sol 12 页）。整页表 RW-sol 28 页/9 篇，RW-sonnet 7/10，CC 1/8。
- **baseline**：t10 CX-sol 同样 36 页，有全量表；RW-sol 对 CX-sol 的差距一部分来自 t07 这一个运行。
- **建议**：逐格、逐基准的全量表交随附数据文件，不排进 PDF；figtab 每项写"正文或附录 + 支持的 claim 编号"，没有 claim 的留仓库。

### D6 预算

- **默认预算**：RW-sol 首批 9 个 timeout（a01 T161537Z、T072333Z，a06 T163613Z、T072433Z，r03 T163233Z，t02 T162604Z，t03 T164156Z，t07 T161159Z，t09 T162034Z）`record.json` 的 `spend.model_s` 2.02–2.41 h，超过默认 `max_model_seconds` 7200 s，回合 29–64；合计 $415，都没有论文。九岗位默认约每岗位 13 分钟模型时间。评测侧已用配置规避（#214）。
- **停止时间**：`budget-origin.json` semantics 为 `wall-clock-since-first-execution-including-pauses`。a06 sol T125220Z 停止 67.7 h，占 168 h 的 40%。停止期间作业账本仍是 running（a06 sonnet 最长作业 34.7 h，净 24.0 h）。
- **建议**：默认预算随岗位数缩放；停止时间不计入预算或单记 `paused_seconds`。

### D7 评审门槛和循环

- **证据**：T051107Z 的 world 内 PR 17 09:06–09:35 驳回 11 次，09:42 通过，每次新 head，"The same single finding is still open"，60 个 PR 全在交付根（对照 T045429Z 10 个）。T045742Z figtab PR 合并后 `paper.pdf` 未重建，07:52 和 08:02 两次阻断（PDF 仍有 4 处 "experiment-repo"）。同一缺陷在 T043502Z 阻断、在 T150830Z 列为 "Non-blocking"；T150830Z 还把数字错误（"as few as 5"，CSV 为 3）列为非阻断。
- **baseline**：无此环节。
- **建议**：`hutian/delivery` 检查加"PDF 文本等于源构建"；评审指南定义阻断（数字错误、声明状态不实的交付文件必须阻断）；version PR 冻结 head。

### D8 字号和放置

- **证据**：10 个 RW-sonnet world 里 7 个有 figtab 自称检查过、内评事后指出的视觉缺陷（a01、r02、r03、t02、t03、t09、t10）。t09 T133153Z 因果清楚：figtab 按 "Width 5.5 in … fonts ≥ 5.5 pt"，paper-repo 用 `width=0.8\linewidth` 放入，内评 "text well below the 5.5 pt"。venue 记录是 ">= 7 pt at final size"（a01 T134049Z），figtab 规格没对齐。t07 T132836Z 图里的 RMSE 比表小约 √20，内评 "contradicts Tables 1/6"。
- **baseline**：无评审日志可比；Stanford 的"稠密"批评各条件接近。这条的价值在省返工，不在分数。
- **建议**：figtab 按最终放置宽度在 PDF 里检查，manifest 记 `include_width`，paper-repo 按它放；字号下限引用 venue 记录；交付前机械检查最小有效字号。

### D9 RW-sol 的 story-repo 审计化

- **证据**：`out/delivery/<sha>/story-repo` RW-sol 对 RW-sonnet：t02 84 文件 67,493 词对 2 文件 3,620 词；t09 70 文件 56,816 词对 2 文件 1,598 词；t03 26 文件对 2 文件。Stanford 清晰度批评"执行日志/审计账目"RW-sol 5/9，CC 和 CX 共 20 篇只有 1 篇。t02 sol 论文 55 处 gate/freeze/ledger 词，同题 sonnet 15 处。
- **把握**：文件数可复核，对论文写法的影响是相关性。
- **建议**：story 限定为问题、分析、比较、负责岗位、验收判据，覆盖审计归内评。

### D10 idea 产出只在 wiki

- **证据**：RW-sonnet `out/delivery/<sha>/idea-repo` 10 个中 7 个只有 42 B 的 README（RW-sol 7–27 文件）。a01 T134049Z idea-repo 1 回合，"I haven't delivered the literature notes"，paper-repo "That wiki isn't readable yet"。`*.wiki.git` 推送被拒在阶段一 a01、a06、r02、t07、t02 和阶段二 5 个 world 出现，岗位绕到 wiki API。
- **建议**：context 提交到 repo 或 release，wiki 只作索引；给 wiki 推送权限或把 API 写进工具说明。

### D11 上游变化重渲

- **证据**：figtab 阶段一 12.1 回合/world，23% 无产出或只有评论，sonnet 回合约 23% 是重渲（关键词粗分）。重渲链：t03 T132413Z 4 条 "Final…"、"Last…"；t02 T132232Z 5 条 "Regenerate…"。t02 T132232Z 前 4 回合都写 "no results exist"。
- **建议**：figtab 交付单命令渲染入口；"最终结果"带版本；结果未出现时不唤醒。

### D12 作业逐个唤醒

- **证据**：收据 `effects` 为空的完成回合：sonnet 311/946（33%），`resource:` 触发 62% 空转，experiment 54%。t02 sonnet 47/82 条回合消息是"没有新结果"，t10 sonnet 45/64。t03 sol 25 条逐检查点审计提交。
- **影响**：单个约 $0.11，空转合计不到花费 10%，合并上限约 $1.7/运行，优先级低于上面各条。
- **建议**：`ht-resource run` 支持作业组，组内最后一个结束才唤醒（未核对现有参数）。

### D13 数值缺陷发现晚和版本错位

- **证据**：t09 sol T124148Z 102 单元、2,937,600 行跑完后发现浮点边界判断错误，3 个分片重跑，PDF "withdraws the earlier numerical conclusions"。a06 sonnet hybrid 行早于估计器修改，K=21 重跑。T045429Z `RESULTS.md` 手写数字错误（2.5 应 2.4；"9–20×"应 5.5–20×）。T051107Z 评审：实验岗位已在 world 内的 PR 18 交付，论文按 PR 16 构建。
- **baseline**：无独立审计记录，不能说 RW 更差；RW 的独立审计是优点，问题在发现得晚。
- **建议**：批量前做小规模端到端验收和边界穷举；结果文档的数字由脚本生成；每次交付附"改变了哪些已交付数字"。

### D14 回合内长作业

- **证据**：T045429Z 第 2 回合触 7212 s 上限，`/tmp` 写满（`ENOSPC`），输出丢失；t02 sonnet 7201 s；t03 sonnet 4 次 timeout；t10 sonnet "My pkill killed my own shell again"。出现在 5 个运行，各 1–4 次。
- **建议**：`/tmp` 余量显示在状态里；shell 超时提示改用 `ht-resource run`；提供 `ht-resource stop`。

### D15 skill 使用

- **证据**：第一版 skill 包 5 个岗位 Skill 调用 0 次（`researchworld-behaviors`）。加 `CLAUDE.md` 后 4 个岗位在前几回合调用；experiment-repo 第二版 4 回合 0 次；第三版指令改为每个会话先看每个 skill 后（T201254Z），第一回合打开全部 5 个 skill。
- **影响**：装上 skill 不等于用上，取决于指令措辞。
- **建议**：岗位指令明确说明可用 skill 的查看时机，或由系统在开工时给出。

### D16、D17（候选，把握低）

- **D16**：story instruction "without forcing a particular conclusion or implementation"；"新颖性有限"RW-sol 5/9、RW-sonnet 3/10、CC 2/10、CX 2/10；每组仅 9–10 篇。建议 PLAN 加"核心贡献陈述"。
- **D17**：a06 sonnet T134424Z idea-review 在高负载下用 fp32 测模型，结论只能用 0.5B；CC-sonnet a06 用 GGUF 跑了 1.5B。建议给上界时至少比较两种运行时。

## 方法和局限

- 复核：D1 的字母序、预检计数、计划与作业先后，D2 的 11/19，D4 的 a01 图注 9 处，D3 的 `-r 40/45`，D5 的 t07，D6 的两个 timeout 花费，都已直接从记录重算；其余数字来自逐运行提取，人工分类的比例只作量级。
- 版面、分页和字号判断基于 pdftotext，看不全实际版面。
- 没有评估"修了这些分数会不会涨"，那需要 #279 的评测机制。
reports.body_en:
Basis: the 19 RW runs of phase 1 `e2e-formal` (RW-sonnet 10, RW-sol 9) against CC-sonnet, CX-sol, AS and EVO on the same tasks; the 11 scored a01 continuations of phase 2 `phase2-e2e`; the external review results of #275. HuTian v4.6.0. No new system run was started, and no model was called to review anything.

## Conclusions

1. **Scores are level, the output is not.** RW-sonnet is 0.05 below CC-sonnet on average and RW-sol 0.17 below CX-sol, both within the noise of the Stanford reviewer (the same content scored twice differs by 0.8 on average). This report therefore does not use score differences to show which problem cost points; it looks at differences in output and process.
2. **Startup should be fixed first.** In all 19 worlds, roles first claimed work strictly in the alphabetical order of their names, so experiment-repo was always first. 15 worlds hit worker-image preflight failures; each failure makes the driver exit and restart, and roles later in the alphabet, such as idea and story, wait from tens of minutes to 7 hours. In 3 of the 4 worlds that started cleanly, story-repo committed before the first compute job; in the other 15 worlds, only 1 did. "Experiments before the plan" comes mainly from this, not from a missing plan gate (D1).
3. **The outside view is often skipped.** external-review is woken only by a `release`, and the instruction allows going straight to `final`. It had a single turn in 11 of 19 phase 1 runs and in 9 of 12 phase 2 a01 runs. When it does read a version, what it raises is substantive and is mostly adopted (D2).
4. **Internal review recomputes and checks reproduction; it is not a venue review.** Of about 108 Stanford weaknesses in 11 runs, internal review mentioned about 35% and asked for changes on about 16%; RW-sol asked for 0, and writing and clarity got 0. No review pointed out paths or script names in the paper, and 7 of 25 runs asked for a figure-to-script map to be added (D3, D4).
5. **Papers are long in the appendix.** Main texts keep the page limit and are as long as the baselines'. Median pages of references and appendix are 20 for RW-sol against 8 for CX-sol, and 8.5 for RW-sonnet against 3.5 for CC-sonnet, much of it full tables under "complete display" headings (D5).

## Same task side by side (Stanford score / pages / repository paths)

| Task | RW-sonnet | CC-sonnet | RW-sol | CX-sol |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a01 | 6.3 / 23 / 14 | 7.1 / 11 / 4 | 7.1 / 22 / 7 | 5.9 / 17 / 2 |
| a06 | 6.7 / 26 / 1 | 7.3 / 21 / 1 | 6.7 / 29 / 7 | 6.7 / 15 / 0 |
| r02 | 6.7 / 25 / 23 | 7.1 / 19 / 1 | 6.2 / 32 / 25 | 6.7 / 25 / 6 |
| r03 | 6.7 / 26 / 23 | 7.1 / 22 / 1 | - | 6.3 / 23 / 3 |
| t02 | 6.8 / 22 / 5 | 6.3 / 12 / 3 | 6.2 / 35 / 12 | 5.4 / 12 / 5 |
| t03 | 6.3 / 20 / 1 | 6.9 / 18 / 4 | 6.7 / 48 / 53 | 6.7 / 12 / 2 |
| t06 | 7.1 / 20 / 12 | 6.7 / 17 / 1 | 6.7 / 21 / 6 | 7.1 / 24 / 6 |
| t07 | 6.9 / 25 / 6 | 6.7 / 20 / 2 | 6.2 / 94 / 14 | 6.9 / 23 / 4 |
| t09 | 6.2 / 26 / 30 | 6.3 / 14 / 0 | 6.1 / 42 / 20 | 6.7 / 16 / 4 |
| t10 | 6.7 / 20 / 3 | 5.4 / 16 / 3 | 5.4 / 36 / 15 | 6.7 / 36 / 5 |

Paired differences (RW minus the single agent on the same model): pages +6.3 for RW-sonnet (higher on all 10 tasks) and +19.9 for RW-sol (higher on 7 of 9); figures +4.3 and +6.0; paths +9.8 and +13.9. A single agent has no internal roles, so baseline comparisons beyond this table are under "baseline" in each item.

The phase 2 a01 arms that swap a role did not open a stable difference: the score differences are within the noise, and the first version of the skill arms never used the skills, so they do not count. Swapping the worker did change the paper and the process (20 to 129 turns, 4 to 60 pull requests), but this report does not judge from that which worker is better.

## Defect table

Ordered by expected gain and size of the change. "RW-specific" means the baselines do not have the same problem.

| id | Role | Type | Problem | RW-specific | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | scheduling | tools and environment; budget and scheduling | Alphabetical start, driver restarts after preflight failures, planning roles arrive late | yes | high |
| D2 | external-review | collaboration and hand-off | Woken only by `release`, skipped when work goes straight to `final` | yes | high |
| D3 | internal-review | internal review misses | Only recomputes and checks reproduction, no venue review; figures often read on low-resolution contact sheets | yes | medium |
| D4 | paper, figtab, internal-review | output quality | Paths, script names in captions and role vocabulary in the paper; review asks for more maps | paths and role words | high |
| D5 | paper, figtab, venue | output quality | Appendix full of complete tables, many never cited in the text | to a greater degree | high |
| D6 | scheduling | budget and scheduling | Default model budget does not scale with the number of roles; stopped time counts against the budget | yes | high |
| D7 | internal-review | collaboration and hand-off | Inconsistent blocking threshold, repeated rejections for stale PDFs, moving head | yes | medium |
| D8 | figtab, paper, venue | output quality | Font size spec and placement width are not connected; visual defects found only in internal review | yes | medium-high |
| D9 | story (RW-sol) | output quality | story-repo becomes a producer of audit and gate documents | yes | medium |
| D10 | idea | collaboration and hand-off | Output only in the wiki, empty delivery directory, wiki pushes refused | yes | medium-high |
| D11 | figtab, paper, experiment | budget and scheduling | A round of re-rendering every time upstream results change; "final" has no version | yes | medium |
| D12 | experiment | budget and scheduling | Shard jobs wake the role one by one, many idle turns, but a low cost ceiling | yes | high |
| D13 | experiment, paper | output quality; collaboration and hand-off | Numerical defects found after bulk production; results and paper out of step | late discovery undetermined | medium |
| D14 | experiment | tools and environment | Long jobs inside a turn, `/tmp` filling up | undetermined | medium |
| D15 | all roles | tools and environment | Skills go unused depending on the instruction's wording | yes | high |
| D16 | story, idea | output quality | Topics lean to diagnostic matrices without a committed positive contribution | no | medium-low |
| D17 | idea-review | internal review misses | Feasibility bounds come from one probe and do not bind the experiments | yes | low to medium |

Not raised separately: the **related-work gap** (Stanford items per paper: RW 1.90, CC 2.20, CX 2.00, the same size) and **experiment scale and coverage** (RW is not systematically smaller).

## Evidence by item

Runs use short ids; the full id is `researchworld-<task>-<short id>`. File paths are relative to the run directory; "role log" means extracted from the `acp-client` events of the world's `observations/runner.sqlite3`.

### D1 Alphabetical start and driver restarts after preflight failures

- **Evidence**: in the `state/home/<world>/observations/world.sqlite3` of 19 worlds, the first `execution.claimed` order matches the alphabetical order of role names 19/19. In `drives/*.json`, drives with `runtime_failure.code = worker-image-preflight-runtime` and empty `executions`: r02 sol T172100Z 66, t06 sol T160918Z 70, t10 sol T170808Z 64, a06 sonnet T134424Z 20, t09 sonnet T133153Z 16, t07 sonnet T132836Z 14, r02 sonnet T134736Z 6; 15 of the 19 worlds have such failures. For example, in t06 sol the first three roles started at 257–262 s and idea-repo at 25316 s; r02 sol first claimed at 21464 s (the run took 7.0 h in all); a06 sonnet idea-review at 7260 s.
- **Plan against experiment**: story's first commit is later than the first compute job in RW-sonnet 7/10 and RW-sol 8/9. In the 4 worlds without preflight failures, story committed first in t02 sonnet, t03 sonnet and t06 sonnet, and 0.1 minutes later in t03 sol.
- **Impact**: 3 sol runs each waited 6–7 h, sonnet 1.2 h per run on average. During preflight failures idea-review cannot advise before costly work: a06 sonnet wrote "That is larger than I bounded"; the a01 sol PLAN says of itself "written after analysis-v1 and presentation-v1 existed, not a preregistration".
- **Baseline**: a single agent does not go through this chain. The preflight failures fall in periods of host overload, tied to how many worlds were running at once (since limited to 4).
- **Advice**: treat docker probe timeouts in the preflight as transient and back off inside the driver instead of exiting; show consecutive failures in `hutian status`; do not start idea, story and idea-review after experiment (no forced dependency is needed).

### D2 external-review skipped

- **Evidence**: turn counts in `receipts/*.json`: 1 turn (the commitment) in 11/19 phase 1 runs and 9/12 phase 2 a01 runs, all of them complete delivery PRs going straight into `final`. Instruction: "A complete delivery may go directly into `final` … an intermediate `release` version is useful when the objective needs interim results, not a prerequisite"; external-review is woken by "a new version … published as a release".
- **Quality when it reads a version** (`external-review-repo` role log): t06 T132616Z found `[PENDING]` left in the abstract; r03 T135113Z found the abstract's numbers come from random 10-fold CV with sibling models of one organisation in the training set; t03 T132413Z found a noise comparison that was not like for like; a06 T134424Z raised 9 items. Adoption: a06 closed all by v3; r03 closed 9 of 11 by v2.
- **No closure**: it judges only published versions. t03 T132413Z, t09 T133153Z and t06 T132616Z ended with "no release newer than v1 … leaving all open", with 13, 10 and 11 items still open when the world ended. In a01 sol T125538Z reading `paper-repo` returned HTTP 403.
- **Advice**: do not let `final` be the first approval while external-review has read no `release`, or wake it on a PR into `final` and give it read access to that head; have the `final` approval list a disposition for every open item.

### D3 Internal review is not a venue review

- **Evidence**: `out/delivery/<sha>/internal-review-repo/reviews/` and role logs against `scores/stanford-agentic-reviewer/review.md` (a01, a06, r02, r03, t03, t09, 11 runs in all): about 108 weaknesses, about 38 mentioned (35%), about 17 asked for as changes (16%). RW-sol mentioned 14/49 and asked for 0/49 (all 7 PR reviews in sol approved). What RW-sonnet asked for was almost all relayed from external-review. Writing and clarity 0 of about 22. Rejection reasons (40 findings): text against table or CSV about 28%, evidence or overclaim about 23%, reproduction and delivery files about 20%, figure layout about 15%. The percentages are hand-judged and only an order of magnitude.
- **Reading figures**: the instruction requires "open and inspect every delivered figure". T045742Z used `pdftoppm -r 45`, and its re-review put 22 pages on one sheet with `-r 40`, recording "figures legible"; T045429Z used `-r 60` and read 2 images (the paper has 10 figures); t10 T133557Z used 80 dpi contact sheets. Codex runs viewed each figure at about 108–144 dpi (a01 T125538Z, a06 T125220Z), so this is mainly a problem of the Claude runs.
- **Noted but not acted on**: t09 sonnet T133153Z "Page 5-6 text is dense. A referee would remark on it", filed as non-blocking.
- **Baseline**: no internal review role; the same weaknesses are in the CC and CX papers. RW's problem is that this gate's effort does not reach them.
- **Advice**: before approving `final`, write a list of a venue reviewer's weaknesses (at least 2 each for technical, experimental, clarity and related work, including "reads like an execution log, paths and scripts in the text"), marking each must-fix, can-fix or accepted with a reason; give an independent judgment on each external-review item (a06, r03 and t06 accepted everything, with no rebuttal seen); view each main figure at print size and record figure, dpi and minimum font size.

### D4 Where the development traces are and where they come from

- **Against the baselines**: script names and commit hashes are no more frequent than for a single agent on the same model (RW-sonnet against CC-sonnet: script names higher on 3 tasks and lower on 6; hashes higher on 1 and lower on 5). What RW clearly has more of is repository paths (median 9 against 1.5; RW-sol against CX-sol 14 against 4).
- **Location** (broad count: scripts, directory paths, data file names): RW-sol 229 hits, 43% in appendix reproduction sections, 48% in other appendices, 3.5% in the text; RW-sonnet 236 hits, 17% in the text, 13% in captions, 17% in the checklist. Mean hits in captions: RW-sonnet 9.6, CC-sonnet 0.7, CX-sol 0.2; median in the text: RW-sonnet 6.5, CC and CX 0.
- **Examples**: a01 T134049Z captions "Generated by `figures/src/tables.py` from …" (9 times in the paper); r02 T134736Z "Source: figures/fig_c3_cov_vs_size.py."; r02 parentheticals `(A3_rank_blocks.csv)`; t03 sol's appendix lists `pip install` and `PYTHONPATH=src python3 tests/test_metrics.py` one by one.
- **Role words only in RW**: RW-sol 4/9 papers "plan owner / analysis owner / presentation owner"; RW-sonnet "the report role" (t03), "review role" (t09), "PR 25" (t02). Of 74 script names in phase 2 T052236Z, 68 are in an appendix "Script-to-output map" table.
- **Source**: captions were written by paper-repo (figtab's `CAPTIONS.md` has no such words); the push comes from figtab's commitment "generator script, input-file list … caption text", the Evidence norm "record which input files a result was made from", and item 2 of the task's `deliverable.md` (the baselines get the same requirement). Internal review also asks for maps: T150440Z "add … a table 'paper Figure/Table number -> command -> inputs'", after which paper-repo added Appendix C. None of 85 reviews in 25 runs points out paths in the paper.
- **Stanford text**: papers criticised for a log-like feel, file paths or dependence on appendices: RW 6/19, CC-sonnet 0/8, CX-sol 0/10 (t03 sol "reads as an execution log", t09 sol "extensive auditing and file-path references", r02 sonnet "many references to CSV/figure filenames"). On the other side, Stanford lists the script map as a strength in 5/19 RW papers and 0/18 baselines, so keep one sentence pointing to the reproduction material.
- **Advice**: state in the report's function that the reader is outside the study, that paths, scripts and file names belong to the accompanying reproduction package, and that the paper keeps at most a one-sentence pointer; put the script map in `REPRODUCE.md`; have figtab separate captions from provenance.

### D5 Appendix pile-up

- **Evidence**: median pages of references and appendix (without the checklist) RW-sol 20, CX-sol 8, RW-sonnet 8.5, CC-sonnet 3.5; main text 8.0, 8.0, 9.0, 7.9. "Complete/Every/All/Full" sections: RW-sol 8/9, CX-sol 5/9, RW-sonnet 2/10, CC-sonnet 1/6. Figures and tables never cited in the text: RW-sonnet 15% against CC 8%; RW-sol 33% (23% without t07) against CX 17%. t07 sol T123915Z has 94 pages, with pages 62–87 "F.8 Complete per-benchmark, all-method results", and 49 of 104 displays uncited. t03 sol T123620Z has 48 pages (CX-sol 12). Full-page tables: RW-sol 28 pages in 9 papers, RW-sonnet 7 in 10, CC 1 in 8.
- **Baseline**: t10 CX-sol also has 36 pages with full tables; part of RW-sol's gap against CX-sol comes from the single t07 run.
- **Advice**: per-cell and per-benchmark full tables go in an accompanying data file, not the PDF; figtab writes "main text or appendix + supported claim id" per display, and a display with no claim stays in the repository.

### D6 Budget

- **Default budget**: the first 9 RW-sol runs timed out (a01 T161537Z, T072333Z; a06 T163613Z, T072433Z; r03 T163233Z; t02 T162604Z; t03 T164156Z; t07 T161159Z; t09 T162034Z), with `spend.model_s` in `record.json` of 2.02–2.41 h, above the default `max_model_seconds` of 7200 s, at 29–64 turns; $415 in all, and no paper. The default is about 13 minutes of model time per role for nine roles. The evaluation side already avoids this in configuration (#214).
- **Stopped time**: the semantics in `budget-origin.json` is `wall-clock-since-first-execution-including-pauses`. a06 sol T125220Z stopped for 67.7 h, 40% of the 168 h. Jobs stay running in the ledger during a stop (the longest job of a06 sonnet shows 34.7 h, 24.0 h net).
- **Advice**: scale the default budget with the number of roles; do not count stopped time against the budget, or record `paused_seconds` separately.

### D7 Review threshold and loop

- **Evidence**: in T051107Z the in-world PR 17 was rejected 11 times between 09:06 and 09:35 and approved at 09:42, on a new head each time, "The same single finding is still open"; 60 PRs all on the delivery root (10 in control T045429Z). In T045742Z, `paper.pdf` was not rebuilt after figtab PRs merged, blocking at 07:52 and 08:02 (the PDF still had 4 occurrences of "experiment-repo"). The same defect blocked in T043502Z and was listed "Non-blocking" in T150830Z; T150830Z also listed a numeric error ("as few as 5", 3 in the CSV) as non-blocking.
- **Baseline**: no such step.
- **Advice**: add "PDF text equals the source build" to the `hutian/delivery` check; define blocking in the review guide (numeric errors and delivery files whose stated status is false must block); freeze the head of version PRs.

### D8 Font size and placement

- **Evidence**: in 7 of 10 RW-sonnet worlds (a01, r02, r03, t02, t03, t09, t10), figtab said it had inspected figures that internal review later found defects in. The cause is clear in t09 T133153Z: figtab used "Width 5.5 in … fonts ≥ 5.5 pt", paper-repo placed the figures at `width=0.8\linewidth`, and review reported "text well below the 5.5 pt". The venue record is ">= 7 pt at final size" (a01 T134049Z), which figtab's spec did not follow. In t07 T132836Z the RMSE shown on a figure is about √20 smaller than in the table, and review wrote "contradicts Tables 1/6".
- **Baseline**: no review logs to compare; Stanford's "dense" remarks are close across conditions. The value of this item is saved rework, not scores.
- **Advice**: figtab checks figures in the PDF at the final placement width, the manifest records `include_width`, and paper-repo places figures by it; take the font size floor from the venue record; check the minimum effective font size mechanically before delivery.

### D9 RW-sol's story-repo turns into an audit desk

- **Evidence**: `out/delivery/<sha>/story-repo` RW-sol against RW-sonnet: t02 84 files, 67,493 words against 2 files, 3,620 words; t09 70 files, 56,816 words against 2 files, 1,598 words; t03 26 files against 2. Stanford's clarity remarks about an "execution log" or "audit accounting": RW-sol 5/9, 1 of 20 in CC and CX together. The t02 sol paper has 55 gate/freeze/ledger words, 15 for sonnet on the same task.
- **Confidence**: the file counts can be checked; the effect on the paper's writing is a correlation.
- **Advice**: limit story to questions, analyses, comparisons, responsible roles and acceptance criteria; coverage audits belong to internal review.

### D10 idea output only in the wiki

- **Evidence**: in 7 of 10 RW-sonnet worlds `out/delivery/<sha>/idea-repo` has only a 42-byte README (RW-sol 7–27 files). a01 T134049Z idea-repo had 1 turn, "I haven't delivered the literature notes", and paper-repo wrote "That wiki isn't readable yet". Pushes to `*.wiki.git` were refused in phase 1 a01, a06, r02, t07 and t02 and in 5 phase 2 worlds; roles moved to the wiki API.
- **Advice**: commit context to the repository or a release and use the wiki only as an index; grant wiki push or document the API in the tool notes.

### D11 Re-rendering when upstream changes

- **Evidence**: figtab averages 12.1 turns per world in phase 1, 23% with no output or only comments, and about 23% of sonnet turns are re-renders (rough keyword split). Request chains: t03 T132413Z four "Final…" and "Last…" requests; t02 T132232Z five "Regenerate…". The first 4 turns of t02 T132232Z all say "no results exist".
- **Advice**: figtab delivers a one-command render entry; "final results" carry a version; do not wake figtab before results exist.

### D12 Jobs waking the role one by one

- **Evidence**: completed turns with empty `effects` in the receipts: sonnet 311/946 (33%); 62% idle for `resource:` wake-ups, 54% for experiment. t02 sonnet has 47/82 "nothing new" turn messages, t10 sonnet 45/64. t03 sol has 25 per-checkpoint audit commits.
- **Impact**: about $0.11 each, under 10% of cost altogether, with a ceiling of about $1.7 per run for merging wake-ups, so it ranks below the items above.
- **Advice**: job groups in `ht-resource run`, waking when the last of a group ends (existing options not checked).

### D13 Late numerical defects and out-of-step versions

- **Evidence**: in t09 sol T124148Z, after 102 cells and 2,937,600 rows, a floating-point boundary error was found, 3 shards were rerun, and the PDF "withdraws the earlier numerical conclusions". In a06 sonnet the hybrid rows predate an estimator change and K=21 was rerun. T045429Z's `RESULTS.md` has hand-written number errors (2.5 should be 2.4; "9–20×" should be 5.5–20×). In T051107Z review notes that the experiment role had delivered in in-world PR 18 while the paper was built from PR 16.
- **Baseline**: no independent audit record, so RW cannot be called worse; RW's independent audit is a strength, and the problem is how late it finds things.
- **Advice**: a small end-to-end acceptance and boundary enumeration before bulk runs; numbers in result documents generated by scripts; each delivery states which delivered numbers changed.

### D14 Long jobs inside a turn

- **Evidence**: T045429Z's second turn hit the 7212 s limit and filled `/tmp` (`ENOSPC`), losing output; t02 sonnet 7201 s; t03 sonnet 4 timeouts; t10 sonnet "My pkill killed my own shell again". 5 runs, 1–4 times each.
- **Advice**: show free `/tmp` in the status; suggest `ht-resource run` on a shell timeout; provide `ht-resource stop`.

### D15 Skill use

- **Evidence**: in the first version of the skill packages, 5 roles made 0 Skill calls (`researchworld-behaviors`). After adding `CLAUDE.md`, 4 roles called skills in their first turns; experiment-repo made 0 calls in 4 turns on the second version; the third version, whose instruction says to look at every skill at the start of each session (T201254Z), opened all 5 skills in the first turn.
- **Impact**: installing a skill is not the same as using it; use depends on the wording of the instruction.
- **Advice**: state in the role instruction when to look at the available skills, or have the system present them at the start of work.

### D16 and D17 (candidates, low confidence)

- **D16**: story's instruction says "without forcing a particular conclusion or implementation"; "limited novelty" RW-sol 5/9, RW-sonnet 3/10, CC 2/10, CX 2/10, with only 9–10 papers per group. Advice: add a "core contribution statement" to the PLAN.
- **D17**: idea-review in a06 sonnet T134424Z measured models in fp32 under high load and concluded only 0.5B was usable; CC-sonnet on a06 ran 1.5B with GGUF. Advice: compare at least two runtimes when giving a bound.

## Method and limits

- Recomputed directly from the records: the alphabetical order, preflight counts and plan-against-job order of D1, the 11/19 of D2, the 9 captions of a01 in D4, the `-r 40/45` of D3, t07 in D5, and the cost of two timeouts in D6. The other numbers come from run-by-run extraction, and hand-classified percentages are only an order of magnitude.
- Layout, pagination and font-size judgments rest on pdftotext, which does not show the whole layout.
- Whether fixing these raises scores was not assessed; that needs the evaluation mechanism of #279.

defects.title: 试跑全部失败也继续往下走
defects.title_en: The pipeline continues after every trial run failed
defects.text: CodeAgent 的 exec-fix 循环用无参数、60 秒超时试跑生成的代码；全部迭代都崩溃时流程照样继续，把没跑通过的代码交给后面的阶段。阶段一 ARC-sol 的 10 道里有 7 道如此（t03 t06 t09 t10 a01 r02 r03）。
defects.text_en: CodeAgent's exec-fix loop runs the generated code once per iteration with no arguments and a 60-second timeout; when every iteration crashes the pipeline carries on anyway and hands code that never ran to the later stages. 7 of the 10 phase 1 ARC-sol tasks went this way (t03 t06 t09 t10 a01 r02 r03).

defects.title: 审查改写后的代码不再试跑
defects.title_en: Code rewritten by review is not run again
defects.text: Review 和后续的 Stage 10 改写会替换代码，最终代码在 Stage 12 之前从未执行过。例：t07 的最终代码新增了必填的 --config，Stage 12 以无参数运行即失败。
defects.text_en: Review and the later Stage 10 rewrites replace the code, so the final code is never executed before Stage 12. Example: the final code of t07 gained a required --config, and Stage 12, which runs it without arguments, failed at once.

defects.title: Stage 12 失败即终止，修复环节用不上
defects.title_en: A Stage 12 failure ends the run; the repair step never gets a chance
defects.text: Stage 12 拒绝零指标结果；修复循环只在 Stage 14 之后运行，所以 repair.enabled / max_cycles 对 Stage 12 的失败不起作用。阶段一 ARC-sol 的 10 道都以 Stage 12 “零真实指标”终止。
defects.text_en: Stage 12 refuses a result with zero metrics; the repair loop only runs after Stage 14, so repair.enabled and max_cycles have no effect on a Stage 12 failure. All 10 phase 1 ARC-sol tasks ended at Stage 12 with zero real metrics.

defects.title: 只禁止部分参数
defects.text: 提示词说明运行方式是无参数的 python main.py，但只点名禁止 --condition / --method；也没有任何静态检查拦下必填参数或子命令。阶段一 ARC-sol 有 5 道因此失败（t06 t07 t09 a01 a06）。
defects.text_en: The prompt says the program is run as a bare python main.py but names only --condition and --method as forbidden, and no static check stops a required argument or subcommand. 5 phase 1 ARC-sol tasks failed this way (t06 t07 t09 a01 a06).

defects.title: 文件解析回退把非代码块当作 main.py
defects.title_en: The file-parsing fallback takes a non-code block for main.py
defects.text: _extract_multi_file_blocks 把没有标注文件名的块当作 main.py。例：a01、r03 的 main.py 内容是 filename:requirements.txt 之类；试跑的 stub 也可能被判为“能运行”（t07）。
defects.text_en: _extract_multi_file_blocks takes a block with no file name for main.py. Example: the main.py of a01 and r03 holds text such as filename:requirements.txt; a trial-run stub can also be judged runnable (t07).

defects.title: 依赖扫描把标准库写进 requirements
defects.title_en: The dependency scan writes standard-library modules into requirements
defects.text: _detect_pip_packages 用正则收集 import，只按手写的 _BUILTIN_PACKAGES 跳过，漏掉 __future__、builtins、traceback、importlib 等；一行无效就让 pip 整体安装失败，真正的额外依赖也装不上；上游 entrypoint 把 pip 输出 | tail -20，失败被隐藏。阶段一这 10 道的失败都发生在用到缺失包之前，所以这一条不是决定因素。2026-11-07 复核：阶段一 ARC-sol 的 10 个运行，第 12 阶段的 pip 输出全部有 ERROR（9 个是 Invalid requirement: '__future__'，t02 是 No matching distribution found for builtins）；a06 还把 docstring 里一行 from explicit finite laws… 当成 import，写进了 explicit。在 ARC 镜像里调用 _detect_pip_packages 扫描一个只有 import 语句的文件，返回 __future__、builtins、traceback、fractions、numbers、gzip、importlib、resource；在实验镜像里 pip install -r 含 builtins 的清单退出码为 1、一个包都不装，set -e 下 pip … | tail -20 照样继续（PIPESTATUS 1 0）。10 个运行里只有 t03 的清单含镜像缺少的包（xgboost），t03 在用到它之前就因缺 experiment.json 失败；全部产物中没有 No module named。镜像文件与上游该 commit 的 docker_sandbox.py、entrypoint.sh 的 sha256 一致。
defects.text_en: _detect_pip_packages collects imports with a regular expression and skips only those in a hand-written _BUILTIN_PACKAGES, missing __future__, builtins, traceback, importlib and others; one invalid line makes the whole pip install fail so the real extra dependencies are not installed either, and the upstream entrypoint pipes pip's output through tail -20, which hides the failure. The failures of these 10 phase 1 tasks all happened before a missing package would have been used, so this one was not decisive. Rechecked 2026-11-07: in all 10 phase 1 ARC-sol runs the stage 12 pip output has an ERROR (9 Invalid requirement: '__future__', t02 No matching distribution found for builtins); a06 also took a docstring line from explicit finite laws... for an import and wrote explicit. Calling _detect_pip_packages in the ARC image on a file of import statements returns __future__, builtins, traceback, fractions, numbers, gzip, importlib and resource; in the experiment image pip install -r on a list with builtins exits 1 and installs nothing, and under set -e pip ... | tail -20 carries on (PIPESTATUS 1 0). Of the 10 runs only t03's list holds a package the image lacks (xgboost), and t03 failed on a missing experiment.json before using it; no artifact contains No module named. The image's docker_sandbox.py and entrypoint.sh match the upstream files of that commit by sha256.

defects.title: 不记录实验容器退出码
defects.title_en: The experiment container's exit code is not recorded
defects.text: t10 跑了 574 秒、写出 5229 个结果文件后非零退出，stdout / stderr 都为空；ARC 不保存退出码，原因无法判断。
defects.text_en: t10 ran 574 seconds, wrote 5229 result files and exited non-zero with empty stdout and stderr; ARC does not keep the exit code, so the cause cannot be told.

defects.title: 各阶段的 max_tokens 在上游写死，没有配置项
defects.title_en: Each stage's max_tokens is hard-coded upstream, with no setting
defects.text: Anthropic 路线上各阶段发给模型的 max_tokens 写在上游代码里：代码代理的蓝图 8192，单次代码生成 8192，修复 16384，其余阶段 4096、8192 或 16384；没有配置项可改。只有 gpt-5、o3、o4 开头的模型名会把代码阶段抬到 16384，Claude 不在内。Codex 路线上 codex-api 把 ARC 发的 max_output_tokens 去掉，没有这个上限，所以 ARC-sonnet 比 ARC-sol 多受一层截断：2026-11-02、03 的 ARC-sonnet 运行（思考已关闭）里，多文件代码和论文文本在这些上限处被截断（t06 完成的运行论文正文只有 695 字，草稿 1590 字；t07、a06 第 10 阶段题目一致性检查失败时 12/27、9/30 个请求恰好在上限）。适配层的 max_tokens_floor（默认 32768，只在 Messages API 路线且思考关闭时经补丁抬高 max_tokens）让两条路线的输出上限一致，不改 ARC 的方法（维护者 2026-11-10 决定保留，#303）；这些格子尚未在新设置下重跑。
defects.text_en: On the Anthropic route the max_tokens each stage sends to the model is written in upstream's code: the code agent's blueprint 8192, the single-shot code generation 8192, repairs 16384, the other stages 4096, 8192 or 16384; no setting changes them. Only a model name starting with gpt-5, o3 or o4 lifts the code stages to 16384, and Claude is not among them. On the Codex route codex-api removes the max_output_tokens ARC sends, so there is no such limit, and ARC-sonnet is cut off more often than ARC-sol: in the ARC-sonnet runs of 2026-11-02 and 03 (thinking off) multi-file code and paper text were cut off at these limits (the completed t06 run has a paper body of only 695 words against a draft of 1590; when the stage 10 topic-experiment alignment check failed on t07 and a06, 12 of 27 and 9 of 30 requests ended exactly at the limit). The adapter's max_tokens_floor (default 32768, raising max_tokens through a patch only on the Messages API route with thinking off) makes the output limit of the two routes equal and does not change ARC's method (the maintainer decided on 2026-11-10 to keep it, #303); these cells have not been rerun under the new settings.

defects.title: 蓝图在 8192 处被截断，退回的单次生成缺最后一个文件
defects.title_en: The blueprint is cut off at 8192 and the single-shot fall-back lacks the last file
defects.text: 代码代理的蓝图请求（max_tokens 8192）在上限处被截断，输出以未闭合的 ```yaml 开头，YAML 解析失败；ARC 退回单次代码生成（同样 8192），生成的最后一个文件（含 main.py 的真实驱动）缺失，main.py 成了 config.py 或 data.py 的近似副本（同文档串、同末行）；试跑几毫秒就“能运行”，第 12 阶段 0.02–1.3 s、零指标。2026-11-02、03 的 5 个 ARC-sonnet 运行（思考已关闭，记了 thinking_tokens 的请求全为 0）里，25–32 个请求中 9–16 个的 output_tokens 恰好等于上限。ARC 不保存原始的单次生成响应，这条链由蓝图、main.py 内容和用量日志的对应关系得出；没有在新设置下重跑过，不能说 max_tokens_floor 已使这些格子通过。
defects.text_en: The code agent's blueprint request (max_tokens 8192) is cut off at the limit, the output starts with an unclosed ```yaml and the YAML does not parse; ARC falls back to single-shot code generation (also 8192), whose last file (the one with main.py's real driver) is missing, so main.py is a near copy of config.py or data.py (same docstring, same last line); the trial run "runs" in milliseconds and stage 12 takes 0.02 to 1.3 s with zero metrics. In the 5 ARC-sonnet runs of 2026-11-02 and 03 (thinking off; every request that logged thinking_tokens shows 0), 9 to 16 of 25 to 32 requests ended with output_tokens exactly at the limit. ARC does not keep the raw single-shot response, so the chain follows from the blueprint, the content of main.py and the usage log; it has not been rerun under the new settings, and it cannot be said that max_tokens_floor makes these cells pass.

defects.title: 模型写的 main.py 要求一个 ARC 从不运行的准备步骤
defects.title_en: The model-written main.py needs a preparation step ARC never runs
defects.text: ARC 只以无参数的 python main.py 运行生成的实验（entrypoint 末行 exec python3 -u main.py），没有任何前置步骤，提示词也只禁止 --condition / --method，没有静态检查拦下对前置文件的依赖。冒烟里 ARC-sol（autoresearchclaw-s00-20261110T210743Z）的 main.py 在入口处调 read_constraints，要求同目录的 constraints_ack.json，其中的哈希和 reviewed 标记只能由模型自己写的 prepare_constraints.py 在人工确认后写出（必填 --reviewed-by 等参数，还要交互输入 REVIEWED）；ARC 的流程里没有这一步，门永远过不了，第 12 阶段 5.2 s 零指标（Run status: incomplete，ValueError Constraints review failed closed），第 10 阶段试跑也因同一个门崩溃（rc=1）。题面文件在实验容器里是适配层的只读挂载，宿主侧副本里的 0 字节文件只是挂载点残影，与失败无关。与 only-some-arguments-forbidden 同族：模型写的程序依赖 ARC 不提供的输入。
defects.text_en: ARC runs the generated experiment only as a bare python main.py (the entrypoint's last line is exec python3 -u main.py), with no step before it, the prompt forbids only --condition / --method, and no static check stops a dependency on a prerequisite file. In the smoke, the main.py of ARC-sol (autoresearchclaw-s00-20261110T210743Z) calls read_constraints at its entry and needs a constraints_ack.json beside it, whose hashes and reviewed flag only the model's own prepare_constraints.py writes after a human confirmation (required --reviewed-by and other arguments, plus an interactive REVIEWED); ARC's pipeline has no such step, so the gate can never pass, and stage 12 ended in 5.2 s with zero metrics (Run status: incomplete, ValueError Constraints review failed closed), the stage 10 trial run having crashed on the same gate (rc=1). In the experiment container the task files are the adapter's read-only mounts; the 0-byte files in the host-side copy are only mount-point remnants and unrelated to the failure. Same family as only-some-arguments-forbidden: the model-written program depends on an input ARC does not provide.

defects.title: 修复的整文件重写被 max_tokens 截断，回退把第一个文件当作 main.py
defects.title_en: A repair's full-file rewrite is cut off by max_tokens and the fall-back takes the first file for main.py
defects.text: 第 10 阶段的深度质量检查发现问题（如 config.py 与 pip 包同名）后，让模型“返回完整的修正文件”，用 _extract_multi_file_blocks 解析，结果里有 main.py 就整体采用并写盘。这个整体重写的响应可能在 max_tokens 处被截断：只匹配有闭合围栏的块，截断处之后的文件（含真正的 main.py）被丢弃；没有 main.py 时 _extract_multi_file_blocks 把解析出的第一个文件改名成 main.py。冒烟里 ARC-sonnet（autoresearchclaw-s00-20261110T223856Z）的重写响应以 stop_reason max_tokens（32768 个输出 token）结束，模型把 config.py 改名 experiment_config.py 并第一个输出，于是只有常量、NumericalError、Timer 的文件成了入口 main.py，data.py 里 from experiment_config import * 指向目录里不存在的模块；第 12 阶段运行它是退出码 0、无任何输出，报零指标。ARC 不保存原始响应，这条链是由文件时间戳、用量日志里的 stop_reason 和上游解析规则推出的。属于 blueprint-truncated-at-8192 同族（截断加 main.py 回退），走的是深度质量修复而不是蓝图或单次生成；抬高 max_tokens_floor 能降低概率、不能消除，是否改变设置待维护者定。
defects.text_en: When stage 10's deep quality check finds a problem (such as config.py sharing a name with a pip package) ARC asks the model to "return the complete corrected files", parses the reply with _extract_multi_file_blocks and, if the result has a main.py, adopts the whole set and writes it to disk. The reply to such a full rewrite can be cut off at max_tokens: only blocks with a closed fence match, so the files after the cut (the real main.py among them) are dropped, and when there is no main.py _extract_multi_file_blocks renames the first parsed file to main.py. In the smoke, the rewrite reply of ARC-sonnet (autoresearchclaw-s00-20261110T223856Z) ended with stop_reason max_tokens (32768 output tokens); the model had renamed config.py to experiment_config.py and output it first, so a file with only constants, NumericalError and Timer became the entry point main.py, and data.py's from experiment_config import * points at a module that is not in the directory; stage 12 ran it with exit code 0 and no output at all and reported zero metrics. ARC keeps no raw response; the chain is inferred from file timestamps, the stop_reason in the usage log and upstream's parsing rules. It belongs to the family of blueprint-truncated-at-8192 (truncation plus the main.py fall-back), through the deep quality repair instead of the blueprint or the single-shot generation; raising max_tokens_floor lowers the odds without removing them, and whether to change the setting is for the maintainer to decide.
